/*mergeSignalEvent*/ MERGE INTO TB_S_SIGNAL_EVENT T USING ( SELECT #{stock_code} AS stock_code, NVL(#{country_code}, 'KR') AS country_code, #{timeframe} AS timeframe, #{signal_type} AS signal_type, NVL(#{signal_grade}, 'INFO') AS signal_grade, NVL(TO_NUMBER(#{score_delta}), 0) AS score_delta, (CASE WHEN #{event_time} IS NULL OR #{event_time} = '' THEN SYSDATE WHEN LENGTH(#{event_time}) = 10 THEN TO_DATE(#{event_time}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE TO_DATE(SUBSTR(#{event_time},1,19), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') END) AS event_time,
TO_NUMBER(#{price_ref}) NULL AS price_ref, #{json_params} AS json_params, #{message} AS message, #{source_job_id} AS source_job_id FROM DUAL ) S ON ( T.STOCK_CODE = S.STOCK_CODE AND T.TIMEFRAME = S.TIMEFRAME AND T.SIGNAL_TYPE = S.SIGNAL_TYPE AND T.EVENT_TIME = S.EVENT_TIME ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.COUNTRY_CODE = S.COUNTRY_CODE, T.SIGNAL_GRADE = S.SIGNAL_GRADE, T.SCORE_DELTA = S.SCORE_DELTA, T.PRICE_REF = S.PRICE_REF, T.JSON_PARAMS = S.JSON_PARAMS, T.MESSAGE = S.MESSAGE, T.SOURCE_JOB_ID = S.SOURCE_JOB_ID WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( STOCK_CODE, COUNTRY_CODE, TIMEFRAME, SIGNAL_TYPE, SIGNAL_GRADE, SCORE_DELTA, EVENT_TIME, PRICE_REF, JSON_PARAMS, MESSAGE, SOURCE_JOB_ID, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( S.STOCK_CODE, S.COUNTRY_CODE, S.TIMEFRAME, S.SIGNAL_TYPE, S.SIGNAL_GRADE, S.SCORE_DELTA, S.EVENT_TIME, S.PRICE_REF, S.JSON_PARAMS, S.MESSAGE, S.SOURCE_JOB_ID, SYSDATE )
